summary: MZ73 MatRIS energy-force fine-tuning job 1505 completed successfully and returned checkpoint candidate 37d1ad07...ad679a. The checkpoint strictly reloads with 4,294,897 finite parameters and improves every frozen TS primary force metric, TS relative-energy RMSE, and adsorption RMSE/p95 metric. It is not promoted because adsorption validation vector max regresses by 0.013814 eV/A (5.398%) and the active no-regression policy provides no tolerance. No path rerun was started.

payload.objective: Decide whether to retain the strict zero-regression adsorption gate or authorize preparation of a second retention-aware MatRIS fine-tuning candidate with validation-based early stopping; do not promote job-1505 checkpoint or rerun the path meanwhile.
current_evidence: Slurm job 1505 left the queue and its producer exit record reports success with exit code 0.
The returned checkpoint hash matches the producer result and differs from the frozen base checkpoint.
Strict CPU reload passes; all 4,294,897 parameters are finite.
Frozen six-structure TS held-out vector RMSE improves from 0.113936 to 0.089651 eV/A; p95 and max also improve.
Frozen TS relative-energy RMSE improves from 0.087341 to 0.084022 eV and remains below the registered 0.10 eV ceiling; lowest-energy identity remains correct.
Four-structure adsorption retention vector RMSE improves from 0.081014 to 0.074227 eV/A and p95 improves from 0.145147 to 0.124704 eV/A.
Adsorption retention vector max worsens from 0.255915 to 0.269729 eV/A, an increase of 0.013814 eV/A or 5.398%.
The active policy requires adsorption retention not to regress and defines no tolerance; therefore the candidate remains non-promoted.
No automatic retry, checkpoint promotion, complete path rerun, AQCat25 audit, VASP, Dimer, TS acceptance, or barrier action occurred.
payload.one_executable_step: Obtain the user's method decision: keep the strict gate and reject this candidate, or separately authorize preparation of a retention-aware second candidate; no remote action is currently authorized.
payload.submission_boundary: Job 1505 authorization is consumed. Its checkpoint candidate is not promoted. Any second fine-tuning run, checkpoint promotion, complete path rerun, AQCat25 audit, VASP micro-NEB, Dimer, TS acceptance, or barrier report requires a new explicit action and applicable review.
done_when: A durable decision records whether the adsorption vector-max increase is an unacceptable regression under the current gate.
If the strict gate remains, checkpoint 37d1ad07...ad679a is rejected for production use.
If a second candidate is requested, a new review-only training design introduces retention-aware checkpoint selection without using frozen held-out TS samples for optimization.
